title: Generation preset
description: A reusable generation preset (presets/<ID>.preset.json): the prompt scaffold, negative prompt and settings for one kind of image, video or audio output. Fields mirror the app's project presets. A preset names no provider or model, so it works with whichever model the project has enabled (SBAI-15331).

entity_type.description: Entity type the preset is written for; empty when it applies to any type.

image_type.description: Shot or sub-kind: headshot, full_body, exterior, interior, product_shot, action_pose; for audio: music, speech, sfx.

system_prompt.description: Instruction to the model that writes the final prompt.

context_prompt.description: The prompt scaffold: framing, look, lighting, motion or sound.

technical_params.description: Model-neutral settings such as aspect_ratio or duration_seconds.
